pretreatment: cleaved into cm2 size pieces, ultrasonically rinsed with purified water, and then cleaned with a 1 : 1 mixture of H2SO4 : H2O2. Subsequently, the silicon surface was hydrogen terminated in a (10 : 1) H2O : HF solution, rinsed, dried with nitrogen and immediately transferred into the ALD reaction chamber
surface_functionalization: hydrogen terminated in a (10 : 1) H2O : HF solution
evidence: Aluminum oxide films were deposited on prime-grade, p-type, B-doped Si(100) wafers (ρ≥ 1 Ω-cm) that were typically cleaved into cm2 size pieces, ultrasonically rinsed with purified water, and then cleaned with a 1 : 1 mixture of H2SO4 : H2O2. Subsequently, the silicon surface was hydrogen terminated in a (10 : 1) H2O : HF solution, rinsed, dried with nitrogen and immediately transferred into the ALD reaction chamber.
